description: This file defines a PHP class 'FormatWithAchievement' implementing the 'ValueFormatter' interface. It provides a method to format achievement values as strings based on predefined constants, translating numerical achievement indicators into human-readable strings.

classes.name: FormatWithAchievement
classes.description: A class that formats achievement indicator values into human-readable strings based on predefined constant values.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Converts an achievement value into a string ('Positive' or 'Negative') based on predefined constants; returns null for unrecognized values.
